name: Gianduiotto
about: A hazelnut chocolate from Piedmont, shaped like a small boat. It is a classic sweet of the Turin region.
tip: Buy it at Guido Gobino on Via Lagrange.

name: Vermouth
about: A fortified wine flavored with herbs. Turin is known for its aperitivo culture, and vermouth is central to it.
tip: Look for the Torino GI label, which marks vermouth made in Turin.

name: Lavazza Coffee
about: Coffee from Lavazza, a brand founded in Turin. It is one of the best-known Italian coffee names.
tip: Buy the 250g bag directly at a Lavazza store.
